population_note: The 2017 census's count for the island of Ndzuwani (Anjouan).
ethnicity_note: Nationality, not ethnicity: INSEED's 2017 census report counts each island's foreign residents by the region of the world of their nationality (Tableau 3) and records no ethnic group, so nationality is shown in its place. Of the island's 327,382 residents, 1,273 are foreign nationals (658 from southern Africa, 251 from the Indian Ocean, 138 from Europe, 72 from central Africa, 69 from Asia, 42 from northern Africa, 29 from western Africa, 11 from eastern Africa, 2 from North America and 1 from the Middle East); the rest are Comorian nationals. A person with more than one nationality is counted under the nationality of origin.
language_note: Which languages the island's residents speak, as the 2017 census counted them, several answers allowed: each share is the percentage of the island's 327,382 residents who speak the language, so the shares add up to more than 100 (Tableau 4). The report gives no table of the one language each person speaks most.
